equations.verification: global integrated charge and deposition/gather adjoint identity
equations.exclusion: no current deposition or local discrete continuity claim

equations.verification: low/Nyquist modes, Poisson energy identity, scaled true residual

equations.relation: standard electric half-kick, magnetic rotation, electric half-kick

equations.verification: transactional seed/counter replay, binomial rate, elastic speed conservation

stability_gates.poisson: finite overflow-safe true residual <= finite max(atol, rtol*r0)
stability_gates.enforcement: PICStepper rejects pre-step, post-push, and post-collision violations before publishing particle state
stability_gates.state_validation: all position/3V arrays, dimensions, bounds, grid, species, and config validate before zero-density handling; metrics must be finite
stability_gates.cyclotron: not applicable to the electrostatic integrated step; standalone Boris is not integrated

charge_representability.method: mantissa/exponent product-ratio with one final binary64 scaling
charge_representability.acceptance: nonzero represented charge requires finite nonzero volumetric density and conserved integrated charge
charge_representability.rejection: unrepresentable volumetric density raises typed PIC error before CPU mutation or Warp launch

energy_refinement_contract.fixture: cold periodic mode over 4 s; dt_fine=0.02 s; dt_coarse=0.1 s

verification_cases: CIC global charge conservation and adjointness
Python/Warp CPU/CUDA CIC and push parity
Nyquist face-field preservation and Poisson energy identity
late-particle MCC rollback of particles, RNG, and counters
extreme-area CPU/Warp charge preservation or typed rejection

integration_gate.cpu_reference_step: small correctness smoke verified for the reduced periodic electrostatic model only
integration_gate.warp_kernels: small correctness parity verified individually for CIC deposition and face-gather/push
integration_gate.warpx_picmi: adapter protocol only; package unavailable during verification
integration_gate.cft_predictive_outputs: prohibited until geometry, boundaries, chemistry, data, and external validation gates pass

checkpoint_policy.identity: grid, species, config, code revision, backend, device, runtime
checkpoint_policy.staggering: positions integer; velocities half-step behind; field is not stored and is recomputed on faces at position step

external_data_policy.lxcat: hash exact downloaded bytes with SHA-256 before parsing
